fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of project role assignments to return.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the value from the previous response's `next` field to continue listing project roles.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for the returned project roles.

fields.name: resourceType
fields.description: Resource type the role applies to.

fields.name: predefinedRole
fields.description: Whether the role is predefined by OpenAI.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the role was last updated.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.description: Identifier of the actor who created the role.

fields.name: createdByUserObj
fields.description: User details for the actor that created the role, when available.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary metadata stored on the role.
